problemStatement: The current runtime judgment chain is locally integrated, but real Provider acquisition, Telegram publication, persisted snapshot, archive manifest, and protected data-branch update have not been proven together on the merged main commit. A hosted workflow success by itself is insufficient; the bound artifacts and source coverage must be checked, and a second later period remains a separate time-dependent gate.

riskAssessment.reason: The authorized non-dry-run workflow may contact public Providers, send the configured Telegram report, and update the data branch. The run must be date-safe, non-secret, bound across artifacts, and fail closed on missing or degraded evidence.

reasons: The Work Item performs a bounded real external publication and durable data-branch write.

preReviewWarnings: Never read back, echo, or store Secret values; record only Secret names and timestamps.
Use an unused current report date and stop if the workflow refuses publication, reports degraded source coverage, or fails before the bound artifact set is available.
Do not treat PUBLISHED as sufficient; verify report/snapshot/input snapshot/receipt/manifest/data commit identity binding.
Preserve explicit UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE, NOT_CONFIGURED, and UNDETERMINED states; do not manually promote raw source observations into a machine Stage.
A single successful run cannot close the later-period cadence requirement or prove judgment quality.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The exact current main workflow can be dispatched with configured production prerequisites without exposing Secret values.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The workflow is active, the three required Secret names exist, data exists, and the selected report date is not already archived.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Record only names/metadata, dispatch through xinglun, and retain the workflow run identity without credential material.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A non-dry-run workflow reaches the real Provider path and reports a published Weekly Radar run.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The run is from current main, uses dry_run=false, emits PUBLISHED, and keeps Provider degradation explicit rather than silently promoting it.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect workflow inputs, commit SHA, PUBLISHED output, source coverage and failure sections in redacted logs.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The same run binds persisted input, final snapshot, rendered report, Telegram receipt, archive manifest, and data branch commit.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Report ID, snapshot ID, input snapshot path, receipt ID/message IDs, manifest binding and data commit are mutually consistent without secret leakage.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Read the data branch artifacts and compare non-secret identities against the workflow output and run SHA.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A later scheduled or manually equivalent weekly period completes without manual code or data repair.
scenarioCoverage.expected: A distinct later period has the same bound artifact evidence and no manual repair; one run alone cannot satisfy this scenario.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Wait for or dispatch a later valid weekly period and append its run, receipt, archive and data commit evidence to the active Summary.

checkpointPolicy.reason: External publication needs an immutable pre-run boundary and a final evidence checkpoint before any archive/PR claim.

acceptance: The workflow runs from exact current main and uses dry_run=false for a non-conflicting current report date; the splitter accepts the Chinese, Japanese, and English judgment-reference headings and regression tests prove each complete section remains source-preserving.
The run shows the configured real Provider path, including SEC and configured official-source coverage; UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE and UNDETERMINED remain visible and are never silently promoted.
The same run binds persisted input snapshot, rendered report, final snapshot, successful Telegram receipt, archive manifest, and data branch commit through non-secret identities.
The workflow and data branch remain protected by their existing guards; no manual source, Telegram, archive, or data repair is used to make the run pass.

A later scheduled or manually equivalent weekly period completes without code/data repair; until that occurs this Work Item remains conditionally incomplete and must not claim unattended production cadence.
The complete AI Cockpit evidence lifecycle, external run evidence, hosted PR checks, merge, close, and clean-state verification pass without storing credentials.
guidelines: Do not read or record Secret values; external credentials remain only in GitHub Secret storage.
Do not manually mutate the data branch or rewrite historical artifacts.
Evidence before claim: bind workflow, source coverage, snapshot, receipt, manifest and commit identities before reporting success.
Keep the machine reference and human reference independent; do not merge, vote, or override either view.
Preserve fail-closed UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE, NOT_CONFIGURED and UNDETERMINED states.
User-facing documentation is about operating behavior, not project-progress narration.

intent.problem: Local tests prove the judgment chain but do not prove that the merged main runtime can acquire real sources, publish the report once, persist the same input and snapshot, archive the receipt, and update the protected data branch.
constraints: Use only the existing Weekly Radar workflow and configured xinglun GitHub authorization.
Never expose or store Secret values.
Run one non-dry-run period with a non-conflicting current date; do not duplicate an existing archive date.
Treat source degradation and UNDETERMINED machine references as explicit states, not failures to conceal.
Do not close the task as fully complete until a distinct later period is also evidenced.
intent.rationale: A real bounded workflow run is the smallest evidence needed to connect the merged runtime to public Providers, Telegram, immutable snapshots, archive receipts and the protected data branch. Keeping the later-period requirement separate prevents one successful run from becoming an unsupported production claim.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User continuation explicitly requests completion of the real production path; approval is limited to declaring the bounded weekly_radar_validation capability and guard, while general production_operation remains prohibited.

rollbackNote: Do not roll back or rewrite a successful data-branch publication manually. If the run fails, preserve the redacted run evidence and use the existing guarded retry/recovery path only when its identity rules authorize it.
